entries.statement: Receipt conformance is decided by a fully specified finite rule set.
tests: profile text: strict JSON, SHA-256 encoding, UTC, reference integrity, requirement-stated derivation

entries.statement: A published vector corpus covers valid, invalid and indeterminate cases.
tests: 21 vectors: valid PASS, FAIL, INDETERMINATE, malformed

entries.statement: Conformance and derived status are two logically separate outputs.
tests: profile section: conformant boolean plus derived_status pass/fail/indeterminate

entries.statement: Non-conformance must never be reported as PASS, FAIL or INDETERMINATE.
tests: normative statement present and testable in profile text

entries.statement: A second implementation by a different party reproduces the vector corpus.
entries.reason: the draft states the conformance bar but no independent implementation record was found as of the measurement date

entries.statement: A false-accept rate under mutation is published.
entries.reason: conformance vectors are not mutation scores; no false-accept number was found

entries.statement: The profile states which requirements are not covered by its 21 vectors.
evidence: profile describes intended narrowness in prose
entries.reason: narrowness is described in prose; no per-requirement ledger was found, so the untested set cannot be enumerated by a machine
